name: Download screenshots
description: Download the screenshots captured during a VMRay analysis run as a ZIP and write it to the playbook's shared storage.

analysis_id.description: VMRay analysis_id (not sample_id) to fetch screenshots for.
analysis_id.title: Analysis Id

encryption_password.description: Password to protect the returned ZIP with, if the archive requires one.
encryption_password.title: Encryption Password

file_path.description: Path (relative to data_path) of the downloaded screenshots ZIP.
file_path.title: File Path
